_comment: Tightened per the 2026-08-13 policy decision: every column is ENFORCED except the four allowed discrepancies in not_comparable. known_gaps is deliberately empty — a disagreement fails the test instead of parking.
_covered_comment: The exact SKUs that reach the export today, pinned so a swap cannot hide behind a stable count. Growth is good news - update the pin.
_min_covered_comment: The sheet's Hill's block was filled from a wider page selection than the two pages recorded here, so only part of it is reachable end to end.

not_comparable.product_name: allowed discrepancy (policy 2026-08-13): the sheet holds a human shorthand; the export holds the supplier's printed description
not_comparable.product name [Rosetta]: allowed discrepancy: a hand-authored retail name, not something the pipeline derives
not_comparable.weight: allowed discrepancy: some catalogues genuinely do not print it, and the sheet hand-measures
not_comparable.sellable_uom: allowed discrepancy: not always capturable from the source — BizOps set the sellable unit themselves

_conformed_comment: Cells conformed to the chosen conventions (user authorization 2026-08-13): MBB text = the export's canonical typed rendering; packaging/basis text = what the page actually prints (a sheet cell asserting unprinted product knowledge is blanked or set to the export's reading). Substantive page-truth corrections are flagged in docs/catalogue/golden-sheet-conformance-ledger.md — the Google Sheet should be edited to match or future re-imports regress.
_capture_comment: Recaptured 2026-08-16 from the current hills_classic.pdf edition — nine per-page envelopes (Science Diet pp1-3, Prescription Diet pp4-9) with page_brand_text; no page prints a supplier letterhead, so supplier_identity_text is absent by observation. Prices are pinned to what the pages PRINT; the golden sheet disagrees on the four covered SKUs and that discrepancy is with BizOps to adjudicate.
